entry.title: InCad 0.12.0: Mirror Solid; a sketch Mirror that follows its original; the Parameters window; Split Gap; Report a Bug
entry.content:
Added

  • Mirror Solid: a mirrored copy of a whole Solid that follows the original until you break the link — or Join / Cut its mirror image into the Solid itself, whole or one side of the plane, to make a half whole.
  • Sketch Mirror: select the shapes, click Mirror, then the mirror line; the copy keeps the original's size and follows it without copying its dimensions. InCad's own Symmetric, and Shift-click selects a whole outline.
  • The Parameters window lists every value with what uses it; Split leaves a gap between the pieces (in 0.05 mm steps); ⚙ ▸ Report a Bug sends a report with the log.

Fixed

  • The Parameters button did nothing visible; Symmetric sometimes caught a dimension's point; Mirror failed when the shape's points lay on the mirror line.
  • Boolean Cut with a clearance refused a tool that can't be grown (an Emboss, a thread): it cuts with 0 mm now and says so; right-click menus show only what applies.
